**mvpmi.apk** — the community app for members (signed with the permanent
release key; installs over earlier versions).

Before installing: in Android settings allow Chrome (or Files) to
"Install unknown apps". Android may show a Play Protect notice because the
app is not from the Play Store — choose "Install anyway".

**app-debug.apk** — test build only (shows a TEST BUILD bar; can connect to a
computer test server). Do not give it to members.
